description.en: Run agents through JSON-RPC over standard input and output for automation.
description.zh: 通过 JSON-RPC 标准输入输出驱动智能体，仅供自动化使用。

description.en: Provide automation-only ACP communication and process lifecycle management over dsh-base.
description.zh: 在 dsh-base 上提供自动化专用的 ACP 通信与进程生命周期。

description.en: Show optional action cards below answers for enabled experiments, and report the user's choices back to the conversation.
description.zh: 为已启用的实验在回答下方显示可选操作卡片，并把用户的选择告知对话。

description.en: Control which methods non-owner connections can access and retain permission snapshots for each connection.
description.zh: 为非所有者连接提供方法级远程访问控制和各连接的权限快照。

description.en: Run Bash commands in local subprocesses.
description.zh: 通过本地子进程执行 Bash 命令。

description.en: Show optional action cards below answers, with each experiment's own controls.
description.zh: 在回答下方显示可选操作卡片，卡片内容由各实验提供。

description.en: Show the proposal card after an answer with location choice, creation progress, retention and undo.
description.zh: 在回答末尾显示方案卡片，含位置选择、创建进度、保留和撤销。

description.en: Customize plugin entries in the left sidebar, conversation views, and right sidebar, and quickly create new plugins.
description.zh: 自定义左侧栏、会话视图和右侧栏显示的插件入口，并快捷创建新插件。

description.en: Drag original files into the composer or other applications, with localized failure feedback.
description.zh: 将原始文件拖入输入框或其他应用，并提供本地化失败提示。

description.en: Browse configured plugin indexes and install their packages.
description.zh: 浏览已配置的插件索引，并安装其中的插件包。

description.en: Show the Enable card for a recommended official plugin after an answer, with its details and your choice.
description.zh: 在回答末尾显示推荐官方插件的启用卡片，含插件详情和你的选择。

description.en: The Automation tasks page in the sidebar, plus task cards and reminder marks in sessions.
description.zh: 侧栏的自动化任务页面，以及会话里的任务卡片和提醒标记。

description.en: Masks recognized keys, tokens, and passwords in sent messages.
description.zh: 遮挡已发送消息中可识别的密钥、令牌与密码。

title.zh: 动态插件浏览器运行器
动态插件服务端运行器

description.en: Proposes a page or small tool you can keep, below the answer; after you click Create it is built in the background as a plugin page that you can cancel, undo and restore. A build takes minutes and many tokens.
description.zh: 想要能长期使用的页面或小工具时，在回答下方提议方案；点击创建后在后台生成插件页面，可取消、撤销和恢复，生成需要几分钟并消耗较多 token。

description.en: Provide shared model guidance for file links and deliverables across application environments.
description.zh: 为不同运行端提供文件链接与交付内容的共享模型指引。

description.en: Manage team members, member messages, and shared tasks.
description.zh: 管理团队成员、成员消息和共享任务。

description.en: Lets the agent you talk to split a job among named teammates, track it on a shared task board, and report back with their results.
description.zh: 让与你对话的智能体把工作分给有名字的队友，在共享任务看板上跟踪进度，并汇总队友的结果向你汇报。

description.en: Provide speech transcription for browser clients.
description.zh: 为浏览器提供录音转写接口。

description.en: Adds an Auto review access mode: before each tool call, a model checks it against what you asked for, runs allowed calls at once, and holds denied calls for your approval.
description.zh: 提供“自动审查”访问模式：每次工具调用前，由模型对照你的要求检查，获准的调用立即运行，被拒绝的调用等你审批。

description.en: Let agents add a “powered by dsh” badge to documents, pull requests, and other outputs.
description.zh: 让 Agent 为文档、PR 等产出添加「powered by dsh」徽章。

description.en: View team members and shared tasks, and navigate to member conversations.
description.zh: 查看团队成员和共享任务，并切换到成员会话。

description.en: Display expanded reasoning in another language using machine translation.
description.zh: 将展开的思考内容机器翻译为其他语言。

description.en: Shows a Session's change requests in a sidebar tab and lets a new Session start in a worktree.
description.zh: 在侧栏标签页中显示会话的变更请求，并让新会话可以在工作树中开始。

description.en: Show per-turn and per-step context, timing, cache, and tool cost beside Chat.
description.zh: 在对话旁展示每轮/每步的上下文、耗时、缓存和工具成本。

description.en: Record speech and insert editable text into the conversation draft.
description.zh: 录制语音，将识别结果填入会话草稿，支持编辑后发送。

description.en: Translates expanded Think rows into your chosen language as the agent writes them, and View original switches back.
description.zh: 智能体输出时，把展开的“思考”行翻译成你选择的语言，点击“查看原文”可切换回原文。

description.en: Register code host providers and poll change request status through one provider-neutral service.
description.zh: 通过一个与提供方无关的服务注册代码托管提供方，并轮询变更请求状态。

description.en: Keep linked GitHub pull requests beside your conversation: follow checks and reviews, inspect diffs, and send feedback to the agent. Review local changes and use a separate worktree to isolate each task. GitHub features require the gh CLI installed and signed in on the host.
description.zh: 在会话侧栏集中跟踪关联的 GitHub PR：查看检查状态、评审意见与代码差异，并把修改建议交给智能体继续处理。也可查看本地改动，用独立工作树隔离任务。GitHub 功能需要本机安装 gh 并登录。

description.en: Read GitHub change requests for the forge registry through the GitHub CLI on the host.
description.zh: 通过宿主上的 GitHub CLI 为 forge 注册表读取 GitHub 变更请求。

description.en: Bind change requests to the Session that created, pushed, or tracked them, and watch their status.
description.zh: 把变更请求绑定到创建、推送或跟踪它们的会话，并监听其状态。

description.en: Press Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+. to open Chrome DevTools in the bottom panel for development and debugging.
description.zh: 按 Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+. 在底部面板打开 Chrome DevTools 进行开发调试

description.en: For troubleshooting: view what DSH recorded for a session in Session log, inspect per-turn and per-step statistics in the Statistics tab, and debug the DSH backend in Chrome DevTools.
description.zh: 用于排查问题：在「会话数据诊断」中查看 DSH 为会话记录的内容，在「统计」页签查看每轮/每步的上下文、耗时、缓存和工具成本，并在 Chrome DevTools 中调试 DSH 后端。

description.en: Share the current Session with a colleague, who can drive it in a browser, edit files inside the granted workspace when the share allows writes, or branch their own Session from the completed history.
description.zh: 把当前会话分享给同事，对方可在浏览器中驱动该会话、在分享允许写入时修改授权工作区内的文件，或从已完成历史分支出自己的会话。

description.en: Adds a Discover tab to Plugins, where you browse and install plugins from plugin indexes you add.
description.zh: 在插件页添加“发现”标签页，从你添加的插件索引中浏览和安装插件。

description.en: Ask for a Ralph loop with a goal, and the agent starts a fresh agent on it round after round until the goal is met, a blocker is reported, or the round limit is reached.
description.zh: 要求用 Ralph 循环完成一个目标后，智能体会一轮接一轮地启动新的智能体处理它，直到目标达成、报告受阻或达到轮次上限。

description.en: Enable analysis of the current session's raw data and grouped chat messages in the session sidebar.
description.zh: 在会话侧边栏启用当前会话的原始数据和聊天分组数据分析功能

description.en: Ask about earlier work, such as “How did we fix the pool leak last week?”, and the agent searches your earlier sessions in the same workspace to answer.
description.zh: 询问以往的工作，例如“上周我们是怎么修好连接池泄漏的？”，智能体会搜索同一工作区的历史会话来回答。

description.en: Writes a session's title from all of your messages and updates it when the main task changes, instead of only from the first message.
description.zh: 根据你的所有消息生成会话标题，并在主要任务变化时更新，而不是只根据第一条消息生成。

description.en: Manage speech transcription and select a recognition service.
description.zh: 管理语音转写服务，并选择识别服务。

description.en: Transcribe recordings into text locally with SenseVoice.
description.zh: 使用本机 SenseVoice 将录音转写为文字。

description.en: Gives the agent terminals whose processes keep running in the background between tool calls, so it can start a dev server or REPL and come back later to read output or type input.
description.zh: 为智能体提供终端，进程在多次工具调用之间持续在后台运行，因此它可以启动开发服务器或 REPL，稍后再读取输出或继续输入。

description.en: Give agents tools to coordinate members, exchange messages, and manage shared tasks.
description.zh: 为智能体提供成员协调、消息通信和共享任务管理工具。

description.en: Ask for work on a new branch, and the agent creates a separate Git worktree and continues there, leaving your current checkout as it is.
description.zh: 要求在新分支上工作时，智能体会创建单独的 Git 工作树并在其中继续，你当前的工作树保持原样。

description.en: Translate text and reuse translations saved in the session.
description.zh: 提供机器翻译，并复用会话中已保存的翻译结果。

description.en: Transcribe recordings locally with SenseVoice; first use requires installing dependencies.
description.zh: 在本机使用 SenseVoice 转写录音，首次使用需安装依赖。

description.en: Create named Git worktrees and change the current session's working directory.
description.zh: 创建命名的 Git 工作树，并切换当前会话的工作目录。

description.en: Access files through the local filesystem.
description.zh: 使用本地文件系统实现文件访问服务。

description.en: Give the model the Harness source directory and Web URL without changing its system prompt.
description.zh: 向模型提供 Harness 源码目录与 Web 地址，不因此改变系统提示词。

description.en: Run a single task directly with the core Agent/Session runner over dsh-base, without a Host, HTTP, or browser layer.
description.zh: 在 dsh-base 上直接使用核心 Agent/Session 执行单次任务，不包含 Host、HTTP 或浏览器层。

description.en: Serve the Web application's entry page and static files, reject paths outside their directory, and return 404 for missing resources.
description.zh: 提供 Web 单页应用的入口与静态资源，拒绝路径越界并为缺失资源返回 404。

description.en: Connect to MCP servers and make their tools available in Harness.
description.zh: 连接 MCP 服务器，并将其工具注册到 Harness。

description.en: Quote selected text and display it as a Markdown block quote.
description.zh: 引用选中的文本，并用 Markdown 引用块展示。

description.en: Shows recommendation cards below the answer for what you want from DSH: when you want a page or small tool you can keep, it proposes a new personalized page, built in the background after you click Create; when you ask how to do something in this app or say a capability is missing, it recommends the built-in plugin that provides it, turned on when you click Enable.
description.zh: 针对你对 DSH 的个性化需求，在回答下方展示推荐卡片：想要能长期使用的页面或小工具时，提议新增个性化页面，点击创建后在后台生成；问到本应用怎么做某件事或缺少某项能力时，推荐对应的内置插件，点击启用后开启。

description.en: Manage configured plugin indexes for plugin discovery and the plugin_market tool.
description.zh: 为插件发现页面和 plugin_market 工具管理已配置的插件索引。

description.en: When you ask how to do something in this app or say a capability is missing, recommends the built-in plugin that provides it below the answer; Enable turns it on for every conversation, and you can turn it off on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 问到本应用怎么做某件事或缺少某项能力时，在回答下方推荐对应的内置插件；点击启用后对所有会话生效，可在插件页关闭。

description.en: Run commands through local PowerShell.
description.zh: 使用本地 PowerShell 实现命令执行服务。

description.en: Stores automation tasks, runs each in its original session when it is due, and gives the agent tools to manage them.
description.zh: 保存自动化任务，到点后在原会话中执行，并为智能体提供管理任务的工具。

description.en: Provide JSON-RPC over standard input and output and manage the process lifecycle over dsh-base.
description.zh: 在 dsh-base 上提供标准输入输出 JSON-RPC 与进程生命周期管理。

description.en: Serve SDK clients in separate processes through JSON-RPC over standard input and output.
description.zh: 通过标准输入输出 JSON-RPC 为独立进程中的 SDK 客户端提供服务。

description.en: Generate session titles from all user messages in the session.
description.zh: 使用会话中的全部用户消息生成标题。

description.en: Provide the official powered-by-DSH badge skill.
description.zh: 提供官方 powered-by-DSH 徽章技能。

description.en: Provide built-in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel workflows and LibreOffice Kit operations.
description.zh: 提供 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 的内置工作流和 LibreOffice Kit 操作。

title.zh: 继承上下文子智能体后端

description.en: Tells the model the current time, the browser's time zone, and the time since the previous message at each step.
description.zh: 每一步把当前时间、浏览器时区和距上一条消息的时长告诉模型。

description.en: Save tmux pane and window locations for each step when needed.
description.zh: 按需保存每一步的 tmux 窗格与窗口位置信息。

title.zh: 插件 API 查询工具

description.en: Executes model tool calls directly.
description.zh: 直接执行模型发起的工具调用。

description.en: Executes tools through run_code programs and generates SDK bindings.
description.zh: 通过 run_code 程序执行工具并生成 SDK 绑定。

description.en: Create, view, update, and delete automated tasks.
description.zh: 提供自动化任务的创建、查看、修改和删除工具。

description.en: Search session history and read trajectories and events according to workspace permissions.
description.zh: 按工作区权限搜索会话历史，并读取轨迹和事件。

description.en: View, create, replace, and insert text through the filesystem service.
description.zh: 通过文件系统服务提供查看、创建、原文替换和按行插入工具。

description.en: Provide six persistent PTY tools with isolated session ownership and background task integration.
description.zh: 提供六个持久 PTY 工具，隔离会话所有权并集成后台任务。

description.en: Read and change the current session's working directory.
description.zh: 读取和修改当前会话的工作目录。

description.en: Provide absolute paths to the bundled Python, Node.js, and pnpm runtimes.
description.zh: 提供内置 Python、Node.js 和 pnpm 的绝对路径。

title.zh: DeepSeek 网页搜索与抓取 API

description.en: Manage session working directories, save directory changes, and provide the model with working-directory context.
description.zh: 管理会话工作目录，保存目录变更并向模型提供上下文。

description.en: Connects a remote MCP server to make its tools available to the agent.
Displays a blue circle below the message composer.
